/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   REFERRAL / EXCHANGES — design premium
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* ══ Popup Tournoi Paper Trading (dashboard) ════════════════ */
.pt-promo-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9000;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.65);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity .3s ease;
}
.pt-promo-overlay.is-open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

.pt-promo-modal {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%; max-width: 480px;
  background: linear-gradient(155deg, #16093a 0%, #1e1040 50%, #160a28 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,110,255,.45);
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 2rem 1.75rem 1.75rem;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.05),
              0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6),
              0 0 100px rgba(124,58,237,.2);
  text-align: center;
  transform: translateY(24px) scale(.95);
  transition: transform .32s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}
.pt-promo-overlay.is-open .pt-promo-modal { transform: none; }

/* Décos */
.pt-promo-glow {
  position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none;
}
.pt-promo-glow--tl {
  top: -60px; left: -60px; width: 220px; height: 220px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(124,58,237,.25) 0%, transparent 70%);
}
.pt-promo-glow--br {
  bottom: -50px; right: -50px; width: 180px; height: 180px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245,158,11,.2) 0%, transparent 70%);
}
.pt-promo-stars {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 18%  22%, rgba(255,255,255,.5) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1px   1px   at 72%  14%, rgba(255,255,255,.4) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 85%  60%, rgba(255,255,255,.35) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1px   1px   at 35%  75%, rgba(255,255,255,.3) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1px   1px   at 55%  38%, rgba(255,255,255,.4) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 8%   55%, rgba(255,255,255,.25) 0%, transparent 100%);
}

/* Fermer */
.pt-promo-close {
  position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1rem;
  width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s; z-index: 2;
}
.pt-promo-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); color: #fff; }

/* Badge live */
.pt-promo-live-wrap { display: flex; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.pt-promo-live {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem;
  font-size: .65rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em;
  color: #4ade80;
  background: rgba(74,222,128,.12); border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.3);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: .25rem .7rem;
}
.pt-promo-dot {
  width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #4ade80; box-shadow: 0 0 7px #4ade80;
  animation: ptPromoDot 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ptPromoDot {
  0%,100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: .5; transform: scale(1.5); }
}

/* Trophy */
.pt-promo-trophy {
  font-size: 3rem; line-height: 1; display: block;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(245,158,11,.55));
  margin-bottom: .75rem;
  animation: ptPromoFloat 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ptPromoFloat {
  0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50%      { transform: translateY(-6px); }
}

/* Titre */
.pt-promo-title {
  font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; color: #fff;
  line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 .9rem;
}
.pt-promo-title-accent {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a78bfa, #fbbf24);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

/* Description */
.pt-promo-desc {
  font-size: .9rem; color: rgba(220,210,255,.85);
  line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}
.pt-promo-desc strong { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }

/* Features */
.pt-promo-feats {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: .4rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.pt-promo-feat {
  font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 600;
  background: rgba(167,110,255,.15); border: 1px solid rgba(167,110,255,.3);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: .28rem .75rem;
  color: #e0d0ff;
}

/* CTA button */
.pt-promo-cta {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem;
  width: 100%; padding: .9rem 1.5rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed 0%, #a855f7 45%, #d97706 100%);
  background-size: 200% 100%; background-position: 0% 50%;
  border-radius: 14px; border: none;
  font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(124,58,237,.45), 0 0 40px rgba(124,58,237,.15);
  transition: background-position .4s ease, box-shadow .2s, transform .15s;
  animation: ptCtaShimmer 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  margin-bottom: .85rem;
}
@keyframes ptCtaShimmer {
  0%,100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
  50%      { background-position: 100% 50%; }
}
.pt-promo-cta:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(124,58,237,.6), 0 0 60px rgba(124,58,237,.2);
  animation-play-state: paused;
  background-position: 100% 50%;
}
.pt-promo-cta-shine {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 35%, rgba(255,255,255,.18) 50%, transparent 65%);
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  animation: ptCtaShine 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ptCtaShine {
  0%     { transform: translateX(-100%); }
  55%,100% { transform: translateX(200%); }
}

/* Note bas de popup */
.pt-promo-note {
  font-size: .72rem; color: rgba(220,210,255,.45);
  margin: 0;
}

/* ── Thème clair ─── */

/* ── Carte exchange ── */
.exchange-link {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem 1rem 1rem 1.2rem;
  border-radius: 16px;
  text-decoration: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  transition: transform var(--fast), box-shadow var(--fast), border-color var(--fast);
}
/* Barre colorée gauche */
.exchange-link::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 3px;
  border-radius: 16px 0 0 16px;
}
/* Shimmer hover */
.exchange-link::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.06), transparent);
  transform: translateX(-130%);
  transition: transform 550ms ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.exchange-link:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
.exchange-link:hover::after { transform: translateX(130%); }
.exchange-link:active { transform: translateY(-1px); }
.exchange-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(124,58,237,.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* ── Logo plateforme (PNG) ── */
.exchange-logo {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 4px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.exchange-logo-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center;
  display: block;
  border-radius: 9px;
}

/* ── Texte central ── */
.exchange-body {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .12rem;
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
}
.exchange-brand {
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #fff; line-height: 1;
}
.exchange-bonus {
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.25;
}
.exchange-label {
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,.38);
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em;
}

/* ── Flèche ── */
.exchange-arrow {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 34px; height: 34px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: #fff; position: relative; z-index: 1;
  transition: transform var(--fast), background var(--fast);
}
.exchange-link:hover .exchange-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

/* ── BLOFIN ── */
.exchange-link-blofin {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,.1) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.025) 100%);
}
.exchange-link-blofin::before { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #10b981, #059669); }
.exchange-link-blofin .exchange-logo-blofin {
  background: #0a0a0a;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.exchange-link-blofin .exchange-bonus { color: #34d399; }
.exchange-link-blofin .exchange-arrow { background: rgba(16,185,129,.18); }
.exchange-link-blofin:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(16,185,129,.25);
}
.exchange-link-blofin:hover .exchange-arrow { background: rgba(16,185,129,.35); }

/* ── BYBIT EU ── */
.exchange-link-bybit {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,158,11,.09) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.025) 100%);
}
.exchange-link-bybit::before { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #f59e0b, #d97706); }
.exchange-link-bybit .exchange-logo-bybit {
  background: #0b111d;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}
.exchange-link-bybit .exchange-bonus { color: #fbbf24; }
.exchange-link-bybit .exchange-arrow { background: rgba(245,158,11,.18); }
.exchange-link-bybit:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(245,158,11,.25);
}
.exchange-link-bybit:hover .exchange-arrow { background: rgba(245,158,11,.35); }

@media (max-width: 420px) {

.btn-disclaimer-secondary {

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LOCKED — état verrouillé V2
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.vp-locked-full {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 54px);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 2rem 1.25rem;
  background: #030308;
}
.vp-locked-bg {
  position: absolute; inset: -8%;
  background-image: var(--vp-thumb, none);
  background-size: cover; background-position: center;
  filter: blur(36px) brightness(.18) saturate(1.5);
  transform: scale(1.05);
  z-index: 0;
}
.vp-locked-vignette {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 25%, rgba(3,3,16,.9) 80%),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(3,3,16,.3) 0%, rgba(3,3,16,.7) 100%);
  z-index: 1;
}
.vp-locked-content {
  position: relative; z-index: 2;
  width: 100%; max-width: 480px;
  text-align: center;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  border-radius: var(--rxl);
  padding: 2.75rem 2rem 2.5rem;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.05),
    0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.6),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06);

.vp-locked-plan { display: inline-flex; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
/* Icône verrou avec animation */
.vp-locked-lock-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 68px; height: 68px; margin: 0 auto 1.4rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.vp-locked-lock-ring {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(124,58,237,.3);
  animation: lock-ring-pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes lock-ring-pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: .5; }
  50%       { transform: scale(1.18); opacity: .15; }
}
.vp-locked-lock-icon {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  animation: lock-icon-float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes lock-icon-float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50%       { transform: translateY(-3px); }
}
.vp-locked-title {
  font-size: clamp(18px, 3vw, 28px);
  font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1.2;

.vp-locked-desc {
  font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.52);
  line-height: 1.7; margin: 0 0 1.85rem;

.vp-locked-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   VIDEO GRID — RESPONSIVE COMPLET
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Tablet intermédiaire : 2 colonnes, cartes compactes */
@media (max-width: 900px) and (min-width: 541px) {
  .videos-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  .video-title { font-size: 13px; }
}

/* Mobile : layout horizontal (thumbnail gauche, info droite) */
@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .videos-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: .65rem;
  }

  /* ── Carte horizontale ── */
  .video-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: stretch;
    border-radius: 16px;
    min-height: 135px;
  }
  .video-card:hover { transform: none; }
  .video-card:active { transform: scale(.985); }

  /* ── Miniature gauche ── */
  .video-thumb {
    width: 152px;
    min-width: 152px;
    aspect-ratio: unset;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 14px 0 0 14px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background-size: contain;
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
  }

  /* ── Chip row dans miniature mobile : une seule puce, alignée à gauche ── */
  .video-chip-row {
    top: .45rem; left: .45rem; right: .45rem;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: .25rem;
  }

  /* ── Play ring : toujours visible sur mobile ── */
  .play-ring {
    width: 32px; height: 32px;
    opacity: .85;
    border-width: 1.5px;
  }
  .lock-ring {
    width: 32px; height: 32px;
    opacity: .85;
  }
  .lock-ring svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
  .play-ring svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-left: 2px; }
  /* Désactive les anneaux concentriques hover sur mobile (pas de hover réel) */
  .play-ring::before, .play-ring::after,
  .lock-ring::before { display: none; }
  /* Désactive le zoom thumb sur mobile (layout horizontal) */
  .video-card:hover .video-thumb { transform: none; }
  .video-card::before { display: none; }

  /* ── Unlock hint toujours visible sur mobile ── */
  .unlock-hint { opacity: 1 !important; font-size: 8px; }

  /* ── Infos droite ── */
  .video-info {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: .65rem .85rem .65rem .8rem;
    gap: .3rem;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  /* ── Tag plan : petite version ── */
  .v-tag {
    font-size: 8.5px;
    padding: 3px 7px;
    letter-spacing: .05em;
  }

  /* ── Titre sur 3 lignes max ── */
  .video-title {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.3;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  /* ── Date + durée en bas ── */
  .video-meta { margin-top: .3rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .2rem .5rem; }
  .video-date     { font-size: 10px; }
  .video-duration { font-size: 10px; }

  /* ── Locked card ── */
  .video-card.locked { }
  .video-card.locked:hover { transform: none; }
  .video-card.locked:active { transform: scale(.985); }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   CONTACT — page redesignée
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.contact-inner { max-width: 880px; }
.contact-page .legal-back { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }

/* Header héro */
.contact-hero {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}
.contact-hero-badge {
  position: relative;
  width: 64px; height: 64px;
  margin: 0 auto 1.25rem;
  border-radius: 18px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--p) 0%, var(--pd) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(124,58,237,.42), 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12) inset;
  animation: ctBadgeFloat 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ctBadgeFloat {
  0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50%     { transform: translateY(-7px); }
}
.contact-hero-badge-ping {
  position: absolute; top: -3px; right: -3px;
  width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--aml);
  border: 2px solid var(--bg);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(252,211,77,.6);
  animation: ctPing 2.2s ease-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ctPing {
  0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(252,211,77,.55); }
  70%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 9px rgba(252,211,77,0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(252,211,77,0); }
}
.contact-hero-title {
  font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 40px);
  font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.045em;
  margin: 0 0 .65rem;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--t1) 0%, var(--pl) 55%, var(--aml) 130%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; color: transparent;
}
.contact-hero-sub {
  font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--t2);
  max-width: 460px; margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Layout */
.contact-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
}
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .contact-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

.contact-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; width: 100%; }

/* Carte formulaire premium */
.contact-form-card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(140% 100% at 0% 0%, rgba(124,58,237,.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
    var(--card);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-radius: var(--rl);
  padding: 1.9rem;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
  transition: border-color var(--mid), box-shadow var(--mid);
}
.contact-form-card:focus-within {
  border-color: rgba(124,58,237,.32);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 60px -22px rgba(124,58,237,.5);
}
/* Liseré dégradé en haut de carte */
.contact-card-accent {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--p), var(--pl) 45%, var(--aml));
  opacity: .9;
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .contact-form-card { padding: 1.4rem; }
}

/* Labels avec icône */
.contact-form .form-label {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem;
}
.contact-form .form-label svg { color: var(--pl); opacity: .85; }

.contact-textarea {
  resize: vertical;
  min-height: 130px;
  font-family: inherit;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.contact-textarea-hint {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem;
  margin-top: .5rem;
  font-size: 11px; color: var(--t3);
}
.contact-textarea-hint svg { color: var(--green); opacity: .8; }

.contact-submit-btn {
  margin-top: .75rem;
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: .95rem;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  border-radius: var(--r2);
}
.req { color: #f87171; margin-left: .1rem; }

/* Sidebar infos */
.contact-sidebar {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .85rem;
}
.contact-info-block {
  position: relative;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem;
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border-radius: var(--r2);
  padding: 1.15rem 1.25rem;
  transition: transform var(--fast), border-color var(--fast), box-shadow var(--fast), background var(--fast);
}
.contact-info-block:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: rgba(124,58,237,.28);
  background: rgba(124,58,237,.045);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -18px rgba(124,58,237,.6);
}
.contact-info-block--rgpd:hover {
  border-color: rgba(239,68,68,.3);
  background: rgba(239,68,68,.04);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -18px rgba(239,68,68,.55);
}
.contact-info-block--secure:hover {
  border-color: rgba(16,185,129,.3);
  background: rgba(16,185,129,.04);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -18px rgba(16,185,129,.5);
}
.contact-info-icon {
  width: 44px; height: 44px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(124,58,237,.12); border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.22);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: var(--pl);
  transition: transform var(--mid);
}
.contact-info-block:hover .contact-info-icon { transform: scale(1.08) rotate(-4deg); }
.contact-info-icon--rgpd {
  background: rgba(239,68,68,.1); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,.22); color: #f87171;
}
.contact-info-icon--secure {
  background: rgba(16,185,129,.1); border-color: rgba(16,185,129,.24); color: #34d399;
}
.contact-info-label {
  font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--t3); text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .08em; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: .3rem;
}
.contact-info-value {
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--t1);
}
.contact-info-value--soft {
  font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--t2); line-height: 1.55;
}
a.contact-info-value:hover { color: var(--pl); }

.contact-disclaimer { margin-top: .35rem; }

/* Flash messages */
.contact-flash {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: .65rem;
  padding: .95rem 1.15rem; border-radius: var(--r2);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5;
  animation: ctFlashIn .4s var(--ease) both;
}
.contact-flash svg { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
@keyframes ctFlashIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
.contact-flash-success {
  background: rgba(110,231,183,.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(110,231,183,.25);
  color: #6ee7b7;
}
.contact-flash-error {
  background: rgba(248,113,113,.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(248,113,113,.25);
  color: #f87171;
}

/* Thème clair — ajustements */
html.light .contact-hero-title {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--t1) 0%, var(--p) 55%, var(--amd) 130%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}
html.light .contact-hero-badge-ping { border-color: #fff; }
html.light .contact-form-card { box-shadow: 0 18px 50px -28px rgba(80,60,160,.4); }
html.light .contact-info-block:hover { background: rgba(124,58,237,.06); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .contact-hero-badge,
  .contact-hero-badge-ping,
  .contact-flash { animation: none; }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PROFILE — champs inline + thème toggle
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.profile-field-group {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .3rem;
}
.profile-field-label {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem;
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em;
  color: var(--t3);
}
.profile-inline-input {
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* Status block */
.profile-status-block {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;
}
.profile-status-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
  padding: .5rem .9rem; border-radius: var(--rf);
}
.profile-status-active {
  background: rgba(16,185,129,.12);
  color: #10b981;
  border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.25);
}
.profile-status-none {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  color: var(--t2);

}

/* Theme toggle */
.theme-toggle-group {
  display: flex; gap: .5rem;
}
.theme-btn {

  background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);

}
.theme-btn:hover  { border-color: rgba(124,58,237,.3); color: var(--t1); }
.theme-btn.active {

  border-color: var(--p);

  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--pglow);
}


/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CONSENT BANNER — Google CMP
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.consent-banner {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 1rem 1rem 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(16px);
  transition: opacity .35s ease, transform .35s ease;
}
.consent-banner.consent-visible {
  pointer-events: auto;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}
.consent-card {
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 700px;
  box-shadow: 0 -8px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 0 1px rgba(124,58,237,.12);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
}
.consent-hd {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem;
  margin-bottom: .65rem;
}
.consent-emoji { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; }
.consent-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--t1); margin: 0; }
.consent-desc {
  font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--t2);
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
}
/* Panneau personnalisation */
.consent-details {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: .65rem .9rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .55rem;
}
.consent-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem;
}
.consent-row-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .08rem; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.consent-row-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--t1); }
.consent-row-sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--t3); }
.consent-always-on {
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #4ade80;
  background: rgba(34,197,94,.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.18);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: .2rem .6rem;
  white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0;
}
/* Toggle switch */
.consent-switch { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.consent-switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; position: absolute; }
.consent-slider {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  border-radius: 22px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
}
.consent-slider::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 16px; height: 16px;
  left: 2px; bottom: 2px;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition: transform .2s;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.consent-switch input:checked + .consent-slider { background: var(--p); border-color: var(--p); }
.consent-switch input:checked + .consent-slider::before { transform: translateX(18px); }
/* Boutons */
.consent-actions {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-bottom: .75rem;
}
.consent-btn {
  flex: 1; min-width: 110px;
  padding: .55rem .75rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity .15s, transform .15s;
  white-space: nowrap; text-align: center;
}
.consent-btn:hover { opacity: .85; }
.consent-btn:active { transform: scale(.97); }
.consent-accept {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #d97706);
  color: #1a0a00; border: none;
}
.consent-reject {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);
  color: var(--t2);
}
.consent-customize {
  background: rgba(124,58,237,.14);
  border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.28);
  color: var(--pl);
}
/* Footer liens */
.consent-footer { font-size: 11px; color: var(--t3); text-align: center; }
.consent-link { color: var(--t3); text-decoration: none; }
.consent-link:hover { color: var(--t2); text-decoration: underline; }

/* Light */
html.light .consent-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.97);
  border-color: rgba(80,60,160,.12);
  box-shadow: 0 -8px 60px rgba(80,60,160,.18), 0 0 0 1px rgba(124,58,237,.07);
}
html.light .consent-details {
  background: rgba(80,60,160,.04);
  border-color: rgba(80,60,160,.1);
}
html.light .consent-slider {
  background: rgba(80,60,160,.15);
  border-color: rgba(80,60,160,.2);
}
html.light .consent-reject {
  background: rgba(80,60,160,.07);
  border-color: rgba(80,60,160,.14);
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .consent-banner { padding: .75rem .75rem 0; }
  .consent-card { padding: 1.1rem 1rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0; }
  .consent-btn { min-width: 0; font-size: 12px; }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PROMO BANNER
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@keyframes promo-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: .6; transform: scale(1); }
  50%       { opacity: 1;  transform: scale(1.06); }
}
@keyframes promo-shimmer {
  0%   { background-position: -200% center; }
  100% { background-position:  200% center; }
}

.promo-banner {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.28);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(212,175,55,.07) 0%, rgba(124,58,237,.08) 100%);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  transition: border-color .2s, transform .2s;
}
.promo-banner:hover { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,.55); transform: translateY(-1px); }

.promo-banner-glow {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 80% at 10% 50%, rgba(212,175,55,.13) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.promo-banner-inner {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.promo-banner-left { flex: 1; min-width: 200px; }

.promo-banner-tag {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold);
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .35rem;
}

.promo-banner-code {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .5rem;
  padding: .35rem .85rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(212,175,55,.12);
  border: 1.5px dashed rgba(212,175,55,.45);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .18s, border-color .18s;
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: .5rem;
  user-select: all;
}
.promo-banner-code:hover { background: rgba(212,175,55,.2); border-color: rgba(212,175,55,.7); }

.promo-code-text {
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  color: var(--gold);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #d4af37, #f5d980, #d4af37);
  background-size: 200% auto;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  animation: promo-shimmer 3s linear infinite;
}

.promo-copy-icon { color: var(--gold); opacity: .8; flex-shrink: 0; }

.promo-copy-tip {
  position: absolute;
  top: -28px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) scale(.8);
  background: var(--gold);
  color: #000;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: .2rem .55rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.promo-copy-tip.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1);
}

.promo-banner-desc {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--t2);
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.promo-banner-desc strong { color: var(--t1); }

.promo-banner-right {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: .5rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.promo-banner-expires {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--t2);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .3rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.promo-banner-expires strong { color: var(--t1); }
.promo-banner-forever { color: #4ade80; }
.promo-banner-forever svg { stroke: #4ade80; }

.promo-countdown {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--gold);
  letter-spacing: .03em;
}

.promo-cta-btn { flex-shrink: 0; }

/* Sub-section variant (plus compact) */
.promo-banner--sub { margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }

/* ── Upsell modal promo hint ──────── */
.upsell-promo-hint {
  margin: .75rem 0 .25rem;
  padding: .75rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(212,175,55,.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: .45rem;
}

.upsell-promo-item {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--t2);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .4rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  position: relative;
}
.upsell-promo-item svg { stroke: var(--gold); flex-shrink: 0; }

.promo-modal-code {
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-bottom: 1.5px dashed rgba(212,175,55,.5);
  padding-bottom: 1px;
  transition: border-color .15s;
}
.promo-modal-code:hover { border-color: var(--gold); }

.promo-modal-copy-tip {
  background: var(--gold);
  color: #000;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: .15rem .4rem;
  border-radius: 5px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity .2s;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.promo-modal-copy-tip.visible { opacity: 1; }

.upsell-promo-note {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--t3, var(--t2));

  padding-top: .25rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);

}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .promo-banner-inner { padding: .85rem 1rem; }
  .promo-banner-right { align-items: flex-start; }
  .promo-banner-expires { white-space: normal; }
}

/* ============================================================
   COMMENTAIRES VIDÉO (vp-comments)
   ============================================================ */
.vp-comments {
  max-width: 820px;
  margin: 2rem auto 3rem;
  padding: 0 1.25rem;
}
.vp-comments-inner {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-radius: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.vp-comments-hd {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1rem 1.4rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.025);
}
.vp-comments-hd-left { display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem; }
.vp-comments-icon {
  width: 28px; height: 28px;
  background: rgba(167,139,250,.15);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: var(--primary, #a78bfa);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.vp-comments-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--t1, #f4f4f5);
}
.vp-comments-badge {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a78bfa, #7c3aed);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: .15rem .5rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}
.vp-comments-list { padding: 0; }
.vp-comments-loading,
.vp-comments-empty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .5rem;
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem;
  color: var(--t3, rgba(255,255,255,.4));
  font-size: 13.5px;
  text-align: center;
}
.vp-comments-spinner {
  width: 20px; height: 20px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(167,139,250,.25);
  border-top-color: var(--primary, #a78bfa);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin .7s linear infinite;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.vp-comment-item {
  padding: 1.1rem 1.4rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  transition: background .15s;
  scroll-margin-top: 80px;
}
.vp-comment-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.vp-comment-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); }
.vp-comment-item.vp-comment-highlight {
  background: rgba(167,139,250,.12);
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--primary, #a78bfa);
}
.vp-comment-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .7rem;
  margin-bottom: .6rem;
}
.vp-comment-avatar {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,.3), rgba(124,58,237,.3));
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.25);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.vp-comment-meta {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .1rem; flex: 1;
}
.vp-comment-author {
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--t1, #f4f4f5);
}
.vp-comment-date {
  font-size: 11px; color: var(--t3, rgba(255,255,255,.4));
}
.vp-comment-badge {
  background: rgba(167,139,250,.15);
  color: var(--primary, #a78bfa);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: .15rem .5rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.2);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.vp-comment-body {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: var(--t2, rgba(255,255,255,.75));
  padding-left: calc(32px + .7rem);
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .vp-comments { padding: 0 .75rem; }
  .vp-comment-body { padding-left: 0; }
}

/* ============================================================
   NOTIFICATIONS (pastille + panneau dashboard)
   ============================================================ */

/* Pastille générique */
.notif-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -4px; right: -4px;
  min-width: 16px; height: 16px;
  background: #ef4444;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800;
  border-radius: 20px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 0 3px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bg, #0e0b1a);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* Bouton cloche mobile */
.mob-notif-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: flex; align-items: center;
}
.mob-notif-btn {
  position: relative;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  border-radius: 10px;
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: var(--t2);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .15s;
}
.mob-notif-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); }

/* Bouton cloche sidebar */
.sb-notif-wrap {
  padding: .35rem .75rem;
  margin-bottom: .25rem;
}
.sb-notif-btn {
  position: relative;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem;
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(167,139,250,.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.15);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: .6rem .9rem;
  color: var(--primary, #a78bfa);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .15s;
}
.sb-notif-btn:hover { background: rgba(167,139,250,.15); }
.sb-notif-badge {
  position: static;
  margin-left: auto;
  border: none;
  top: auto; right: auto;
}

/* Panneau notifications */
.notif-panel {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 360px;
  max-width: 100vw;
  background: var(--surface, #1a1428);
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  box-shadow: -8px 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  z-index: 1200;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  animation: slideInRight .2s ease;
}
@keyframes slideInRight {
  from { transform: translateX(20px); opacity: 0; }
  to   { transform: translateX(0);    opacity: 1; }
}
.notif-backdrop {
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  z-index: 1199;
}
.notif-panel-hd {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .5rem;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.notif-panel-title {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--t1);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.notif-panel-actions {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end;
}
.notif-read-all {
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--primary, #a78bfa);
  background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
  padding: .25rem .5rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: background .15s;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .3rem;
}
.notif-read-all:hover { background: rgba(167,139,250,.12); }
.notif-dismiss-all {
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600;
  color: rgba(239,68,68,.8);
  background: none; border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.2); cursor: pointer;
  padding: .25rem .6rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, color .15s;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .3rem;
}
.notif-dismiss-all:hover { background: rgba(239,68,68,.1); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,.4); color: #ef4444; }
.notif-dismiss-all:disabled { cursor: default; }
.light .notif-dismiss-all { color: #dc2626; border-color: rgba(220,38,38,.25); }
.light .notif-dismiss-all:hover { background: rgba(220,38,38,.07); border-color: rgba(220,38,38,.45); }
.notif-list {
  flex: 1; overflow-y: auto;
}
.notif-item {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: .8rem;
  padding: .95rem 1.25rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background .12s;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.notif-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); }
.notif-item-read { opacity: .6; }
/* Notif "nouvelle vidéo" — icône dorée */
.notif-item-ico-video {
  background: rgba(212,175,55,.12) !important;
  color: var(--gold, #d4af37);
}
.notif-item-ico {
  width: 34px; height: 34px;
  background: rgba(167,139,250,.12);
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: var(--primary, #a78bfa);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.notif-item-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.notif-item-title {
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--gold, #d4af37);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
  margin-bottom: .2rem;
}
.notif-item-sub {
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--t3);
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin-bottom: .35rem;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.notif-item-meta {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
}
.notif-plan {
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
  padding: .1rem .45rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
}
.notif-plan-spot {
  background: rgba(212,175,55,.12);
  color: var(--gold, #d4af37);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2);
}
.notif-plan-rocket {
  background: rgba(167,139,250,.12);
  color: var(--primary, #a78bfa);
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.18);
}
.notif-item-date { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--t3); }
.notif-dot {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  background: #ef4444;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: .3rem;
}
.notif-empty {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
  padding: 3rem 1rem;
  color: var(--t3);
  text-align: center;
}
.notif-empty-ico { font-size: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: .25rem; }
.notif-empty p { font-size: 13.5px; margin: 0; }

/* Bouton retour mobile — caché sur desktop */
.notif-mob-back {
  display: none;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: none; border: none;
  color: var(--t1); cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin-right: .15rem;
  transition: background .15s;
}
.notif-mob-back:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); }
.light .notif-mob-back:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,.06); }

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .notif-panel {
    width: 100vw;
    border-left: none;
    /* Hauteur dynamique : tient compte de la barre du navigateur iOS/Android */
    height: 100dvh;
    top: 0; bottom: auto;
  }
  .notif-mob-back { display: inline-flex; }
}
/* Scroll fluide sur iOS dans la liste */
.notif-list {
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior-y: contain;
}

/* ============================================================
   PUSH NOTIFICATIONS — banner + card profil
   ============================================================ */
/* ── Bannière push — barre fixe pleine largeur en haut ─── */
/* ── Bannière "duels reçus" (toutes pages membres, injectée en JS) ── */
.duel-pending-banner {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem; padding: .85rem 1.15rem;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(124,58,237,.18), rgba(245,158,11,.12));
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.35);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -18px rgba(124,58,237,.7);
  animation: dpbIn .35s var(--ease) both;
}
@keyframes dpbIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.dpb-main { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .85rem; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.dpb-badge {
  flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .25rem;
  font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 900; color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #a78bfa);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: .3rem .7rem;
  animation: dpbPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes dpbPulse { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(124,58,237,.45); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(124,58,237,0); } }
.dpb-texts { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.dpb-title { font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--t1); margin-bottom: .35rem; }
.dpb-list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; }
.dpb-item {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
  font-size: .76rem; padding: .25rem .6rem; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
.dpb-vs { color: var(--t2); }
.dpb-vs strong { color: var(--t1); }
.dpb-time { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; color: #fca5a5; white-space: nowrap; }
.dpb-time--expired { opacity: .5; }
.dpb-gain { font-weight: 800; color: #34d399; white-space: nowrap; }
.dpb-gain--free { color: var(--t3); font-weight: 600; }
.dpb-cta {
  flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .3rem;
  font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; text-decoration: none;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #a78bfa);
  padding: .5rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px;
  transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s;
}
.dpb-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(124,58,237,.4); }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .duel-pending-banner { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: .7rem; padding: .85rem 1rem; }
  .dpb-cta { justify-content: center; }
}
html.light .duel-pending-banner { background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(124,58,237,.1), rgba(245,158,11,.08)); border-color: rgba(124,58,237,.25); }
html.light .dpb-item { background: rgba(80,60,160,.05); border-color: rgba(80,60,160,.12); }
html.light .dpb-time { color: #dc2626; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .dpb-badge, .duel-pending-banner { animation: none; } }

.push-banner {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  z-index: 500; /* au-dessus du mob-header (400) */
  width: 100vw;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4f1fa8 0%, #7c3aed 45%, #9d4edd 70%, #b45309 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 24px rgba(124,58,237,.45), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  animation: pushBannerSlideDown .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both;
}
@keyframes pushBannerSlideDown {
  from { transform: translateY(-100%); opacity: 0; }
  to   { transform: translateY(0);     opacity: 1; }
}
.push-banner-inner {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .85rem;
  max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto;
  padding: .65rem 1.25rem;
}
.push-banner-icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 34px; height: 34px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: #fff;
}
.push-banner-text {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0;
}
.push-banner-text strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: .1rem;
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
}
.push-banner-text span {
  font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); line-height: 1.4;
}
.push-banner-btn {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: #fff !important;
  color: #7c3aed !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.2) !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.push-banner-btn:hover {
  background: #f5f0ff !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.25) !important;
}
.push-banner-close {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); border: none; cursor: pointer;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); padding: .35rem;
  border-radius: 6px; transition: color .15s, background .15s;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.push-banner-close:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.25); }

/* Décaler le contenu de la page pour ne pas cacher la barre du dessous */
body.push-banner-visible .mob-header {
  top: 40px; /* hauteur de la bannière */
}
body.push-banner-visible .app {
  padding-top: calc(56px + 40px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
}
/* Sur desktop (sidebar visible) : décaler uniquement le contenu */
@media (min-width: 769px) {
  body.push-banner-visible .app {
    padding-top: 40px;
  }
  body.push-banner-visible .sidebar {
    top: 40px;
    height: calc(100dvh - 40px);
    height: calc(100vh - 40px); /* fallback */
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .push-banner-inner { padding: .55rem .9rem; gap: .6rem; }
  .push-banner-text span { display: none; }
  .push-banner-text strong { font-size: 12.5px; }
  .push-banner-btn { font-size: 12px !important; padding: .35rem .75rem !important; }
}

/* ── iOS Install Wizard — Modal popup ────────────────────── */
.push-ios-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.75);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  z-index: 9999; padding: 1rem;
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}
.push-ios-modal {
  background: #160d30;
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.2);
  border-radius: 22px;
  width: 100%; max-width: 450px;
  padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.25rem;
  position: relative;
  max-height: 92vh; overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
}
.push-ios-modal-close {
  position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1rem;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); border: none; cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--t2); font-size: 13px;
  width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.push-ios-modal-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); color: var(--t1); }
.push-ios-modal-counter { font-size: 11px; color: var(--t3); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; margin-bottom: .3rem; }
.push-ios-modal-title { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--t1); margin-bottom: .35rem; }
.push-ios-modal-sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--t3); line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 1rem; }
.push-ios-progress { display: flex; gap: .45rem; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; }
.push-ios-dot { flex: 1; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); transition: background .25s; }
.push-ios-dot.active { background: var(--pl); }
.push-ios-step-panel {}
.push-ios-step-img {
  width: 100%; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  margin-bottom: 1rem; background: rgba(8,4,20,.7); line-height: 0;
}
.push-ios-step-img svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.push-ios-step-title { font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--t1); margin-bottom: .45rem; }
.push-ios-step-desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--t3); line-height: 1.55; margin: 0; }
.push-ios-step-desc strong { color: var(--t2); }
.push-ios-modal-nav {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  margin-top: 1.25rem; gap: .6rem;
}
.push-ios-modal-footer {
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--t3); line-height: 1.5; margin-top: .9rem;
  padding: .6rem .8rem;
  background: rgba(167,139,250,.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.12);

.vp-comment-img {

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Bandeau Telegram (espace membre) — v2 premium glassmorphism
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.member-telegram-banner {
  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
  padding: 0;
  border-radius: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 90% at 0% 0%,   rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 90% at 100% 100%, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.16) 0%, transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14, 20, 45, 0.88) 0%, rgba(20, 14, 40, 0.88) 100%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.15);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.15);
  box-shadow:
    0 12px 40px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) inset;
  overflow: hidden;
  animation: mtgBannerIn .55s cubic-bezier(.22,.85,.35,1) both;
}
@keyframes mtgBannerIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
/* Shimmer discret qui traverse la carte au hover */
.member-telegram-banner::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: -100%;
  width: 40%; height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.06), transparent);
  transform: skewX(-20deg);
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: left .9s ease;
}
.member-telegram-banner:hover::before { left: 130%; }

/* Page vidéo : padding:0 !important sur .video-page-main → on remet les marges sur le banner */
.video-page-main > .member-telegram-banner {
  margin: 1.5rem 1.5rem 0;
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .video-page-main > .member-telegram-banner {
    margin: 1rem 1rem 0;
  }
}
.member-telegram-banner-inner {
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0.95rem 1.1rem 1rem;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.member-telegram-banner-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.8rem;
}
.member-telegram-banner-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
}

/* Icône Telegram avec halo pulsant */
.member-telegram-banner-icon {
  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18), rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.08));
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 16px rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.4));
}
.member-telegram-banner-icon::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -3px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: mtgIconPulse 2.6s ease-out 1s infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes mtgIconPulse {
  0%   { transform: scale(.9);  opacity: .7; }
  100% { transform: scale(1.25); opacity: 0;  }
}
.member-telegram-banner-icon svg {
  display: block;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
}

.member-telegram-banner-head-text {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.member-telegram-banner-kicker {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .4rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #7dd3fc;
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin: 0 0 0.35rem;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, .10);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, .22);
}
.member-telegram-banner-kicker::before {
  content: '';
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #22d3ee;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #22d3ee;
  animation: mtgDotPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes mtgDotPulse {
  0%,100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50%     { opacity: .45; transform: scale(.8); }
}
.member-telegram-banner-text {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--t1);
  margin: 0;
}
.member-telegram-banner-text strong { color: #e0f2fe; font-weight: 700; }

.member-telegram-banner-dismiss {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  color: var(--t3);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background .22s, color .22s, border-color .22s, transform .22s;
}
.member-telegram-banner-dismiss span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: -1px;
}
.member-telegram-banner-dismiss:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  color: var(--t1);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}
.member-telegram-banner-actions {
  padding-left: calc(44px + 0.85rem);
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
}

/* CTA Telegram avec shimmer interne et flèche animée */
.member-telegram-banner-btn {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #229ed9 0%, #1a8fc7 60%, #7c3aed 140%);
  background-size: 180% 100%;
  background-position: 0% 0%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow:
    0 6px 18px rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.4),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06) inset;
  transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, background-position .5s;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.member-telegram-banner-btn::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: -100%;
  width: 60%; height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.3), transparent);
  transform: skewX(-20deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.member-telegram-banner-btn:hover {
  background-position: 100% 0%;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.55), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.1) inset;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.member-telegram-banner-btn:hover::after {
  animation: mtgBtnShine .9s ease-out;
}
@keyframes mtgBtnShine {
  from { left: -60%; }
  to   { left: 160%; }
}
.member-telegram-banner-btn svg { transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2); }
.member-telegram-banner-btn:hover svg { transform: translate(2px, -2px); }

html.light .member-telegram-banner {
  border-color: rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.45);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 90% at 0% 0%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 90% at 100% 100%, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15) 0%, transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #ffffff 0%, #eaf4ff 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.14), 0 2px 8px rgba(80, 60, 160, 0.08);
}
html.light .member-telegram-banner::before {
  background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 0%, rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.18) 50%, transparent 100%);
}
/* Icône + halo pulsant — clair */
html.light .member-telegram-banner-icon {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35), rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.18));
  border-color: rgba(14, 116, 165, 0.4);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 14px rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.35));
  color: #0c4a6e;
}
html.light .member-telegram-banner-icon svg { color: #0c4a6e; }
html.light .member-telegram-banner-icon::after {
  border-color: rgba(14, 116, 165, 0.5);
}
/* Kicker pastille — clair */
html.light .member-telegram-banner-kicker {
  color: #0c4a6e;
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18);
  border-color: rgba(14, 116, 165, 0.32);
}
html.light .member-telegram-banner-kicker::before {
  background: #0891b2;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.7);
}
html.light .member-telegram-banner-text { color: #1e293b; }
html.light .member-telegram-banner-text strong { color: #0c4a6e; }
/* Bouton Telegram — clair (garde le gradient cyan→violet, mais ombre plus soft) */
html.light .member-telegram-banner-btn {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
  box-shadow:
    0 8px 20px rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.35),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) inset;
}
html.light .member-telegram-banner-btn:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(34, 158, 217, 0.48), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) inset;
}
html.light .member-telegram-banner-dismiss {
  border-color: rgba(80, 60, 160, 0.14);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
  color: var(--t3);
}
html.light .member-telegram-banner-dismiss:hover {
  background: #fff;
  color: var(--t1);
  border-color: rgba(80, 60, 160, 0.3);
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .member-telegram-banner {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    border-radius: var(--rl);
  }
  .member-telegram-banner-inner {
    padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem 0.85rem;
  }
  .member-telegram-banner-main {
    gap: 0.65rem;
  }
  .member-telegram-banner-head {
    gap: 0.5rem 0.55rem;
  }

  }
  .member-telegram-banner-icon svg {
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
  }
  .member-telegram-banner-actions {
    padding-left: calc(40px + 0.55rem);
  }
  .member-telegram-banner-kicker {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  }
  .member-telegram-banner-text {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    line-height: 1.52;
  }
  .member-telegram-banner-dismiss {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
  }
  .member-telegram-banner-actions {
    padding-left: 0;

  }

    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.65rem 1rem;

  }

@media (max-width: 380px) {
  .member-telegram-banner-kicker {
    font-size: 0.65rem;

  }

  }
}

/* ── Badge Unlock modal ──────────────────────────────────────── */
#badge-unlock-canvas {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 9000;
}

.badge-unlock-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  z-index: 9100;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .3s ease;
}
.badge-unlock-overlay.visible { opacity: 1; }

.badge-unlock-modal {
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1a0a38 0%, #0d0520 60%, #0a0a1a 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.4);
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 2.5rem 2rem 2rem;
  max-width: 360px;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(124,58,237,.25), 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  transform: translateY(32px) scale(.96);
  transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}
.badge-unlock-overlay.visible .badge-unlock-modal {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
}

/* Fermer */
.badge-unlock-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: .9rem;
  right: .9rem;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: .75rem;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.badge-unlock-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); color: #fff; }

/* Étiquette */
.badge-unlock-label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .4rem;
  background: rgba(124,58,237,.2);
  border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.4);
  border-radius: 99px;
  padding: .3rem .9rem;
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #c4b5fd;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
}

/* Icône animée */
.badge-unlock-icon-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100px;
  height: 100px;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}
.badge-unlock-icon-ring {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 3px solid #7c3aed;
  animation: badge-ring-pulse 1.6s ease-out infinite;
}
.badge-unlock-icon-ring-2 {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid rgba(124,58,237,.3);
  animation: badge-ring-pulse 1.6s ease-out .4s infinite;
}
.badge-unlock-icon-inner {
  width: 100px;
  height: 100px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, rgba(196,181,253,.15), rgba(124,58,237,.1));
  border: 3px solid rgba(124,58,237,.5);
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(124,58,237,.35), inset 0 0 20px rgba(124,58,237,.1);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2.8rem;
  animation: badge-icon-pop .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) .1s both;
}

@keyframes badge-ring-pulse {
  0%   { transform: scale(1);   opacity: .8; }
  100% { transform: scale(1.6); opacity: 0; }
}
@keyframes badge-icon-pop {
  from { transform: scale(.4) rotate(-15deg); opacity: 0; }
  to   { transform: scale(1)  rotate(0deg);   opacity: 1; }
}

/* Textes */
.badge-unlock-badge-name {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
}
.badge-unlock-badge-desc {
  font-size: .85rem;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.badge-unlock-xp {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .4rem;
  background: rgba(245,158,11,.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.3);
  border-radius: 99px;
  padding: .3rem .9rem;
  font-size: .8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #f59e0b;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

/* Bouton */
.badge-unlock-cta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: .5rem;
  width: 100%;
  padding: .8rem 1.2rem;

  border-radius: 12px;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: .9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(124,58,237,.35);
}
.badge-unlock-cta:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(124,58,237,.45);
}

/* Multi-badges note */
.badge-unlock-more {
  font-size: .75rem;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  margin-top: .8rem;
}

/* Thème clair */
.light .badge-unlock-modal {

}
.light .badge-unlock-badge-name  { color: #1e1b4b; }
.light .badge-unlock-badge-desc  { color: rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
.light .badge-unlock-label       { background: rgba(124,58,237,.1); }
.light .badge-unlock-close       { border-color: rgba(0,0,0,.12); background: rgba(0,0,0,.05); color: rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
.light .badge-unlock-more        { color: rgba(0,0,0,.35); }

@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .badge-unlock-modal { padding: 2rem 1.4rem 1.6rem; }
  .badge-unlock-icon-inner { width: 84px; height: 84px; font-size: 2.4rem; }
  .badge-unlock-icon-wrap  { width: 84px; height: 84px; }
}

/* ── Popup campagne marketing ────────────────────────────────────
   Design : dark purple / gold glassmorphism
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.cp-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 9100;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .65);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .3s ease;
}
.cp-overlay.cp-visible { opacity: 1; }
.cp-overlay.cp-visible .cp-modal { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }

.cp-modal {
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1c0a40 0%, #0e0625 55%, #080818 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, .25);
  border-radius: 24px;
  width: calc(100% - 2rem);
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 90dvh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 1px rgba(167,139,250,.08),
    0 0 60px rgba(124, 58, 237, .25),
    0 32px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
  transform: translateY(28px) scale(.97);
  transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: rgba(124, 58, 237, .3) transparent;
}
.cp-modal::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
.cp-modal::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
.cp-modal::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(124, 58, 237, .3); border-radius: 99px; }

/* Bouton fermer */
.cp-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: .9rem;
  right: .9rem;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .6);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}
.cp-close:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12); color: #fff; }

/* Image */
.cp-img-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.cp-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}
.cp-img-gradient {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 40%, rgba(14, 6, 37, .95) 100%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Corps texte */
.cp-body {
  padding: 1.6rem 1.8rem 1.8rem;
}
.cp-img-wrap + .cp-body { padding-top: 1.2rem; }

/* Tag "Offre exclusive" */
.cp-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .35rem;
  font-size: .68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .09em;
  color: #f59e0b;
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, .12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, .25);
  border-radius: 99px;
  padding: .25rem .75rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.cp-title {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: #fff;
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin-bottom: .75rem;
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
}

.cp-desc {
  font-size: .9rem;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .65);
  line-height: 1.65;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

/* Actions */
.cp-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .9rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cp-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .5rem;
  padding: .75rem 1.4rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed 0%, #5b21b6 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, .3);
  border-radius: 12px;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: .9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s, filter .15s;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(124, 58, 237, .35);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cp-cta:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(124, 58, 237, .5);
  filter: brightness(1.08);
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.cp-cta svg { flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform .15s; }
.cp-cta:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); }

.cp-skip {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .35);
  font-size: .82rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: .4rem .2rem;
  transition: color .15s;
}
.cp-skip:hover { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .6); }

/* Thème clair */
.light .cp-modal {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #ede9fe 0%, #f5f3ff 60%, #faf5ff 100%);
  border-color: rgba(124, 58, 237, .2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(124, 58, 237, .12), 0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
}
.light .cp-close { background: rgba(0,0,0,.06); border-color: rgba(0,0,0,.1); color: rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
.light .cp-close:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,.1); color: #000; }
.light .cp-title { color: #1e1b4b; }
.light .cp-desc  { color: rgba(0,0,0,.6); }
.light .cp-skip  { color: rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
.light .cp-skip:hover { color: rgba(0,0,0,.6); }
.light .cp-img-gradient { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 40%, rgba(237,233,254,.98) 100%); }

/* ── Responsive mobile ───────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .cp-overlay { padding: 1rem; }
  .cp-modal   { width: calc(100% - 2rem); border-radius: 20px; }

  .cp-img-wrap { border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0; aspect-ratio: 16 / 6; }

  .cp-body { padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem 1.4rem; }
  .cp-img-wrap + .cp-body { padding-top: .9rem; }

  .cp-title { font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .cp-desc  { font-size: .83rem; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; }
  .cp-tag   { font-size: .63rem; margin-bottom: .7rem; }

  .cp-actions { flex-direction: column; gap: .5rem; }
  .cp-cta  { width: 100%; justify-content: center; padding: .8rem 1rem; font-size: .85rem; }
  .cp-skip { width: 100%; text-align: center; }
}

/* Paysage mobile : masque l'image pour gagner de la hauteur */
@media (max-height: 500px) {
  .cp-img-wrap { display: none; }
  .cp-modal    { max-height: 95dvh; }
}
