/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Avatar Frame — Electric
   Anneau conic-gradient rotatif + glow animé multi-couches
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── Wrapper ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* Taille auto (enfant à px explicites) ou via --av-size hérité */
.av-frame-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width:  var(--av-size, auto);
  height: var(--av-size, auto);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

/* Fixe la taille héritée dans les contextes Leaderboard
   (lb-av-clip utilise width/height 100% → a besoin d'un parent explicite) */
.lb-row-level    { --av-size: 36px; }
.lb-podium-level { --av-size: 56px; }
.lb-podium-card[data-rank="1"] .lb-podium-level { --av-size: 68px; }
.lb-modal-avatar { --av-size: 72px; }

/* Isolation pour mix-blend-mode des couches enfants */
.av-frame-wrap--electric { isolation: isolate; }

/* ── Base commune des couches ────────────────────────────── */
.av-elec-border,
.av-elec-glow-1,
.av-elec-glow-2,
.av-elec-overlay,
.av-elec-ambient {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ── 1. Halo ambiant coloré — plus large, plus saturé ────── */
.av-elec-ambient {
  inset: -16px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(244,114,182,.5) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 70%, rgba(103,232,249,.45) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(circle, rgba(167,139,250,.5) 0%, transparent 70%);
  filter: blur(12px);
  animation: elec-ambient 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  z-index: 0;
}

/* ── 2. Glow externe pulsant — multi-couches box-shadow ──── */
.av-elec-glow-1 {
  inset: -6px;
  box-shadow:
    0 0  0  1.5px rgba(192,132,252,.6),
    0 0 12px 4px  rgba(167,139,250,.65),
    0 0 24px 6px  rgba(103,232,249,.45),
    0 0 38px 8px  rgba(244,114,182,.28);
  animation: elec-glow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* ── 3. Anneau principal rotatif — gradient saturé épais ── */
/* Masque radial : ne garde que les 4 px extérieurs → anneau */
.av-elec-border {
  inset: -4px;
  background: conic-gradient(
    from 0deg,
    #c084fc  0%,
    #f0abfc 12%,   /* rose pâle */
    #67e8f9 24%,   /* cyan vif */
    #a78bfa 38%,   /* violet */
    #f472b6 50%,   /* rose vif */
    #67e8f9 64%,
    #c084fc 78%,
    #f472b6 90%,
    #c084fc 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 4px), #fff calc(100% - 4px));
          mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 4px), #fff calc(100% - 4px));
  animation: elec-spin 2.4s linear infinite, elec-flicker 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  filter:
    drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(192,132,252,.85))
    drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(103,232,249,.55));
  z-index: 3;
}

/* ── 4. Anneau accent contre-rotatif — sparkles colorés ─── */
.av-elec-glow-2 {
  inset: -2px;
  background: conic-gradient(
    from 90deg,
    transparent 0deg,
    #67e8f9     30deg,
    transparent 60deg,
    transparent 150deg,
    #f472b6     180deg,
    transparent 210deg,
    transparent 300deg,
    #a78bfa     330deg,
    transparent 360deg
  );
  -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 2px), #fff calc(100% - 2px));
          mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 2px), #fff calc(100% - 2px));
  animation: elec-spin-rev 4.5s linear infinite;
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  opacity: .9;
  z-index: 4;
}

/* ── 5. Éclair / spark balayant l'anneau ─────────────────── */
.av-elec-overlay {
  inset: -4px;
  background: conic-gradient(
    from 0deg,
    transparent 0deg,
    rgba(255,255,255,.95) 6deg,
    rgba(240,171,252,.6) 14deg,
    transparent 24deg,
    transparent 360deg
  );
  -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 5px), #fff calc(100% - 5px));
          mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 5px), #fff calc(100% - 5px));
  animation: elec-spark 3.2s linear infinite;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.9));
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  z-index: 5;
}

/* ── L'avatar reste lisible au-dessus des couches arrière ─ */
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .sb-avatar,
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .mob-avatar,
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .lb-av-clip,
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .poll-cmt-av,
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .shop-frame-preview-avatar,
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .shop-frame-modal-avatar,
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .pt-lb-row-av,
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .pt-lb-pod-av,
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .pt-lb-row-av img,
.av-frame-wrap--electric > .pt-lb-pod-av img {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* ── Keyframes ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
@keyframes elec-spin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to   { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes elec-spin-rev {
  from { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  to   { transform: rotate(0deg); }
}

@keyframes elec-spark {
  0%   { transform: rotate(0deg);   opacity: 1; }
  50%  { opacity: .55; }
  100% { transform: rotate(720deg); opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes elec-flicker {
  0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(192,132,252,.85)) drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(103,232,249,.55)) brightness(1.05); }
  35%      { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(192,132,252,1))   drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(103,232,249,.8))  brightness(1.35); }
  60%      { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(192,132,252,.7))  drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(103,232,249,.45)) brightness(.95); }
  80%      { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(244,114,182,.9))  drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(167,139,250,.7))  brightness(1.25); }
}

@keyframes elec-glow {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0  0   1px  rgba(192,132,252,.45),
      0 0  8px 3px  rgba(167,139,250,.5),
      0 0 18px 5px  rgba(103,232,249,.3),
      0 0 30px 6px  rgba(244,114,182,.18);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow:
      0 0  0   2.5px rgba(192,132,252,.85),
      0 0 18px 6px   rgba(167,139,250,.8),
      0 0 32px 9px   rgba(103,232,249,.6),
      0 0 50px 11px  rgba(244,114,182,.4);
  }
}

@keyframes elec-ambient {
  0%   { opacity: .55; transform: scale(.85) rotate(0deg); }
  50%  { opacity: .9;  transform: scale(1.08) rotate(180deg); }
  100% { opacity: 1;   transform: scale(1.2) rotate(360deg); }
}

/* ── Réduit les animations si l'OS le demande ───────────── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .av-elec-border,
  .av-elec-glow-2,
  .av-elec-overlay,
  .av-elec-ambient { animation: none; }
  .av-elec-glow-1 {
    animation: none;
    box-shadow:
      0 0  0  2px   rgba(192,132,252,.7),
      0 0 14px 5px  rgba(167,139,250,.6),
      0 0 26px 7px  rgba(103,232,249,.4);
  }
}

/* ── Halo réduit : sidebar desktop + header mobile (avatar 32px) ── */
/* :has() = pas de changement HTML requis ; cible uniquement sb/mob-avatar */

/* Isolation GPU : empêche les couches animées de déclencher le
   calcul d'overflow du .sidebar-inner (= fin du scrollbar flash) */
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .sb-avatar),
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .mob-avatar) {
  contain: layout;
  will-change: transform;
}

.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .sb-avatar)  .av-elec-ambient,
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .mob-avatar) .av-elec-ambient {
  inset: -7px;
  /* blur réduit + pas de saignement hors du conteneur sticky */
  filter: blur(5px);
  will-change: transform, opacity;
}
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .sb-avatar)  .av-elec-glow-1,
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .mob-avatar) .av-elec-glow-1 {
  inset: -3px;
  animation: elec-glow-sm 1.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  will-change: box-shadow;
}
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .sb-avatar)  .av-elec-border,
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .mob-avatar) .av-elec-border {
  inset: -2px;
  -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 2.5px), #fff calc(100% - 2.5px));
          mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 2.5px), #fff calc(100% - 2.5px));
  /* Supprime le drop-shadow filter qui saigne hors de l'élément
     et déclenche les recalculs d'overflow dans .sidebar-inner */
  filter: none;
  will-change: transform;
}
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .sb-avatar)  .av-elec-glow-2,
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .mob-avatar) .av-elec-glow-2 {
  inset: -1px;
  -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 1.5px), #fff calc(100% - 1.5px));
          mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 1.5px), #fff calc(100% - 1.5px));
  will-change: transform;
}
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .sb-avatar)  .av-elec-overlay,
.av-frame-wrap--electric:has(> .mob-avatar) .av-elec-overlay {
  inset: -2px;
  -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 3px), #fff calc(100% - 3px));
          mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 3px), #fff calc(100% - 3px));
  will-change: transform;
}
/* Keyframe glow dédié à la version petite (spreads réduits) */
@keyframes elec-glow-sm {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0  0   1px  rgba(192,132,252,.5),
      0 0  5px 2px  rgba(167,139,250,.55),
      0 0 10px 3px  rgba(103,232,249,.35),
      0 0 16px 3px  rgba(244,114,182,.18);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow:
      0 0  0  1.5px rgba(192,132,252,.8),
      0 0  8px 3px  rgba(167,139,250,.75),
      0 0 16px 4px  rgba(103,232,249,.55),
      0 0 22px 5px  rgba(244,114,182,.32);
  }
}

/* ── Preview boutique — carte cosmétique ────────────────── */
.av-frame-wrap--preview {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
}
.shop-frame-preview-avatar {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(124,58,237,.2);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 26px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Preview boutique — modal héro ─────────────────────── */
.av-frame-wrap--modal-preview {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
}
.shop-frame-modal-avatar {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(124,58,237,.25);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 30px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Electric glow for the shop card */
.shop-action-card-glow--electric {
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(124,58,237,.35) 0%, transparent 70%);
}

/* Electric hero in modal */
.shop-modal-hero--electric {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,.25) 0%, rgba(6,182,212,.15) 50%, rgba(16,185,129,.15) 100%);
}
.shop-modal-hero--electric .shop-modal-hero-orb {
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(124,58,237,.45) 0%, transparent 70%);
}

.shop-modal-hero-frame-preview {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: .5rem;
}

/* Cosmetics section identifier */
.shop-action-card--cosmetic {
  min-height: 220px;
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DUEL RESULT POPUP
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#duel-result-canvas {
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 10500;
  display: none;
}
#duel-result-canvas.is-active { display: block; }

.duel-res-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.72);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  z-index: 10600;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity .3s ease;
}
.duel-res-overlay.is-open {
  opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto;
}

.duel-res-modal {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0e0e1f 0%, #141428 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.35);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 2rem 1.75rem 1.75rem;
  width: min(480px, calc(100vw - 2rem));
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 2rem);
  overflow-y: auto;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.7), 0 0 60px rgba(124,58,237,.15);
  transform: scale(.88) translateY(24px);
  transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
}
.duel-res-overlay.is-open .duel-res-modal {
  transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
}

/* Badge / icone résultat */
.duel-res-badge {
  width: 72px; height: 72px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 1rem;
  font-size: 2rem;
}
.duel-res-badge--win  { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245,158,11,.22) 0%, transparent 70%); border: 2px solid rgba(245,158,11,.5); }
.duel-res-badge--loss { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(239,68,68,.18) 0%, transparent 70%);  border: 2px solid rgba(239,68,68,.4);  }
.duel-res-badge--draw { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(99,102,241,.18) 0%, transparent 70%); border: 2px solid rgba(99,102,241,.4);  }

.duel-res-title {
  font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.03em;
  margin: 0 0 .3rem;
}
.duel-res-title--win  { color: #f59e0b; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(245,158,11,.45); }
.duel-res-title--loss { color: #ef4444; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(239,68,68,.35); }
.duel-res-title--draw { color: #a5b4fc; }

.duel-res-sub { color: var(--t3); font-size: .9rem; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; }
.duel-res-sub strong { color: var(--t1); }

/* Joueurs */
.duel-res-players {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: .75rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}
.duel-res-player {
  flex: 1;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1rem .75rem;
  position: relative;
  transition: border-color .2s;
}
.duel-res-player--winner {
  border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.45);
  background: rgba(245,158,11,.07);
}
.duel-res-player--loser { opacity: .7; }

.duel-res-vs {
  align-self: center;
  font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .1em;
  color: var(--t3); flex-shrink: 0;
}

.duel-res-av {
  width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--g1);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--p);
  margin: 0 auto .5rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
.duel-res-av img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.duel-res-crown { font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: .2rem; }
.duel-res-name  { font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--t2); margin-bottom: .35rem; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.duel-res-val   { font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--t1); }
.duel-res-pnl   { font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; margin-top: .15rem; }
.duel-res-pnl--pos { color: #22c55e; }
.duel-res-pnl--neg { color: #ef4444; }
.duel-res-pnl--zero{ color: var(--t3); }

/* XP */
.duel-res-xp {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: .4rem 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700;
}
.duel-res-xp-label { color: var(--t3); }
.duel-res-xp-val--pos { color: #f59e0b; }
.duel-res-xp-val--neg { color: #ef4444; }
.duel-res-xp-val--zero{ color: var(--t3); }

/* Actions */
.duel-res-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .65rem; }
.duel-res-cta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #6d28d9);
  color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: .9rem;
  padding: .75rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 10px;
  transition: opacity .15s, transform .15s;
}
.duel-res-cta:hover { opacity: .9; transform: translateY(-1px); }
.duel-res-close {
  background: none; border: none; color: var(--t3);
  font-size: .82rem; cursor: pointer;
  padding: .4rem; transition: color .15s;
}
.duel-res-close:hover { color: var(--t1); }

@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .duel-res-modal   { padding: 1.5rem 1rem 1.25rem; }
  .duel-res-title   { font-size: 1.4rem; }
  .duel-res-players { gap: .5rem; }
  .duel-res-av      { width: 40px; height: 40px; font-size: .9rem; }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ▓▓▓ PAGE VIDÉO — REFINEMENT VISUEL & MICRO-ANIMATIONS ▓▓▓
   Sur-ensemble de styles ajouté pour magnifier la page vidéo
   sans toucher au template HTML / JS.
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── Entrées séquentielles (fade + slide) ─────────────────── */
@keyframes vpFadeUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}
@keyframes vpFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes vpScaleIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.96); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

.vp-hero,
.vp-player-stage,
.vp-desc-card,
.vp-side-card,
.vp-tournament-promo,
.vp-comments {
  animation: vpFadeUp .6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both;
}
.vp-player-stage      { animation-delay: .04s; }
.vp-desc-card         { animation-delay: .14s; }
.vp-side > *:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: .08s; }
.vp-side > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .14s; }
.vp-side > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .2s;  }
.vp-side > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .26s; }
.vp-comments          { animation-delay: .18s; }

/* ── HERO : overlay animé + scintillements ────────────────── */
.vp-hero { isolation: isolate; }

/* Aurora qui se déplace lentement */
.vp-hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -30% -10%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(45% 35% at 18% 28%, rgba(167,139,250,.22) 0%, transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(40% 30% at 82% 18%, rgba(236,72,153,.12) 0%, transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(50% 40% at 60% 80%, rgba(124,58,237,.18) 0%, transparent 65%);
  filter: blur(40px);
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: vpAurora 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  opacity: .85;
}
@keyframes vpAurora {
  0%   { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0deg); }
  50%  { transform: translate3d(2%,-1%,0) rotate(2deg); }
  100% { transform: translate3d(-2%,1%,0) rotate(-2deg); }
}

/* Étoiles discrètes dans le hero */
.vp-hero::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 12% 22%, rgba(255,255,255,.35) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1px   1px   at 68% 12%, rgba(255,255,255,.4)  0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 84% 58%, rgba(255,255,255,.32) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1px   1px   at 32% 78%, rgba(255,255,255,.28) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1px   1px   at 52% 36%, rgba(255,255,255,.42) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 8%  62%, rgba(255,255,255,.22) 0%, transparent 100%);
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: vpStars 12s ease-in-out infinite;
  opacity: .6;
}
@keyframes vpStars {
  0%, 100% { opacity: .25; }
  50%      { opacity: .65; }
}
html.light .vp-hero::after { display: none; }

/* Titre : reveal en cascade */
.vp-hero-title {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.78) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  animation: vpFadeUp .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .1s both;
}
html.light .vp-hero-title {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a0a3c 0%, #3b1d8a 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

/* Chip : léger lift au hover */
.vp-chip {
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s, color .2s;
}
.vp-chip:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
html.light .vp-chip:hover {
  background: #fff;
  border-color: rgba(80,60,160,.28);
  color: var(--t1);
}

/* Règle décorative : largeur grandit en entrée */
.vp-hero-rule {
  width: 0;
  animation: vpRuleGrow .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .35s forwards;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(167,139,250,.4);
}
@keyframes vpRuleGrow { to { width: 52px; } }

/* ── PLAYER : breathing glow + bordure conic animée ────────── */
.vp-player-glow {
  animation: vpGlowBreath 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes vpGlowBreath {
  0%,100% { opacity: .75; transform: scale(.98); }
  50%     { opacity: 1;   transform: scale(1.04); }
}

.vp-ratio {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}
/* Anneau de lumière conique (rotation lente derrière la vidéo) */
.vp-ratio::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -2px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: conic-gradient(from 0deg,
    rgba(167,139,250,.55),
    rgba(236,72,153,.0),
    rgba(245,158,11,.4),
    rgba(167,139,250,.0),
    rgba(167,139,250,.55));
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: vpRingSpin 14s linear infinite, vpRingFade 1s ease-out .35s forwards;
  filter: blur(2px);
}
@keyframes vpRingSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes vpRingFade { to { opacity: .55; } }
html.light .vp-ratio::before { opacity: 0; animation: none; }

/* ── RÉACTIONS : sweep au hover + active state plus chaud ──── */
.vp-reaction-btn {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.vp-reaction-btn::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 35%, rgba(255,255,255,.14) 50%, transparent 65%);
  transform: translateX(-130%);
  transition: transform .55s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.vp-reaction-btn:hover::after { transform: translateX(130%); }
.vp-reaction-btn:hover .vp-reaction-emoji { transform: scale(1.18) rotate(-5deg); }
.vp-reaction-emoji { transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }

.vp-reaction-btn.active {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(212,175,55,.25), 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,.3);
  animation: vpReactGlow 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes vpReactGlow {
  0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(212,175,55,.2), 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,.3); }
  50%     { box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(212,175,55,.35), 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,.5); }
}

/* ── BOUTON « j'ai tradé » : glow doux quand actif ─────────── */
.vp-traded-btn.active {
  animation: vpTradedGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes vpTradedGlow {
  0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,222,128,.25), 0 0 14px rgba(74,222,128,.16); }
  50%     { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,222,128,.4),  0 0 26px rgba(74,222,128,.32); }
}

/* ── DESC CARD : barre gauche qui s'illumine au hover ──────── */
.vp-desc-card {
  position: relative;
  transition: border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s, transform .25s;
}
.vp-desc-card:hover {
  border-left-color: rgba(167,139,250,.85);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3), -3px 0 28px rgba(124,58,237,.18);
  transform: translateX(2px);
}
.vp-desc-icon { transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .25s; }
.vp-desc-card:hover .vp-desc-icon {
  transform: rotate(-6deg) scale(1.08);
  background: rgba(124,58,237,.22);
}
html.light .vp-desc-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(80,60,160,.16), -3px 0 22px rgba(124,58,237,.12); }

/* ── SIDE CARD : gradient outline subtil au hover ─────────── */
.vp-side-card {
  position: relative;
}
.vp-side-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,.35), rgba(236,72,153,.2), transparent 60%);
  -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
          mask-composite: exclude;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .3s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.vp-side-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

/* ── NOTES HINT : petit bounce au survol ──────────────────── */
.vp-notes-hint .vp-notes-hint-icon { transition: background .25s, transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }
.vp-notes-hint:hover .vp-notes-hint-icon { transform: scale(1.12) rotate(-8deg); }

/* ── TOURNAMENT PROMO : trophée qui flotte ─────────────────── */
.vp-tp-trophy {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: vpTpFloat 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin: center bottom;
}
@keyframes vpTpFloat {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
  33%      { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(-3deg); }
  66%      { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(2deg); }
}
.vp-tournament-promo:hover .vp-tp-trophy {
  animation-duration: 1.6s;
}
.vp-tp-glow {
  animation: vpTpGlow 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes vpTpGlow {
  0%,100% { opacity: .8; transform: scale(1); }
  50%     { opacity: 1;  transform: scale(1.18); }
}
.vp-tournament-promo {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.vp-tournament-promo::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 38%, rgba(255,255,255,.08) 50%, transparent 62%);
  transform: translateX(-130%);
  transition: transform .65s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.vp-tournament-promo:hover::after { transform: translateX(130%); }

/* ── EXCHANGE LINKS : logo qui se redresse au hover ────────── */
.exchange-logo-img {
  transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
}
.exchange-link:hover .exchange-logo-img {
  transform: scale(1.08) rotate(-3deg);
}
.exchange-link {
  will-change: transform;
}

/* ── DISCLAIMER : icône qui tremble au hover ───────────────── */
.vp-disclaimer-icon-wrap { transition: transform .25s; }
.vp-disclaimer:hover .vp-disclaimer-icon-wrap { animation: vpShake .5s ease-in-out; }
@keyframes vpShake {
  0%, 100%   { transform: rotate(0); }
  25%        { transform: rotate(-8deg); }
  50%        { transform: rotate(6deg); }
  75%        { transform: rotate(-4deg); }
}

/* ── COMMENTS : entrée des items en cascade ────────────────── */
.vp-comments-inner {
  position: relative;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  transition: border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s;
}
.vp-comments-inner:hover {
  border-color: rgba(167,139,250,.18);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.22), 0 0 0 1px rgba(167,139,250,.08);
}
.vp-comment-item {
  animation: vpFadeUp .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both;
}
.vp-comment-item:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: .05s; }
.vp-comment-item:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .12s; }
.vp-comment-item:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .19s; }
.vp-comment-item:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .26s; }
.vp-comment-item:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: .33s; }
.vp-comment-item:nth-child(n+6) { animation-delay: .4s; }

.vp-comment-avatar {
  transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .3s;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(167,139,250,.16);
}
.vp-comment-item:hover .vp-comment-avatar {
  transform: scale(1.08) rotate(-4deg);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(167,139,250,.32);
}

.vp-comment-badge {
  transition: background .2s, color .2s;
}
.vp-comment-item:hover .vp-comment-badge {
  background: rgba(167,139,250,.25);
}

/* Highlight #comment-X plus marqué */
.vp-comment-item.vp-comment-highlight {
  animation: vpHighlightPulse 3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes vpHighlightPulse {
  0%   { background: rgba(167,139,250,.32); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--primary, #a78bfa), 0 0 0 1px rgba(167,139,250,.4); }
  50%  { background: rgba(167,139,250,.18); }
  100% { background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }
}

/* ── LOCKED : meilleur effet de profondeur ────────────────── */
.vp-locked-content {
  animation: vpScaleIn .6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both;
}
.vp-locked-lock-wrap {
  position: relative;
}
.vp-locked-lock-wrap::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: -8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(167,139,250,.22) 0%, transparent 70%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  z-index: -1;
  animation: vpGlowBreath 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.vp-locked-btn {
  transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s, filter .2s;
}
.vp-locked-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  filter: brightness(1.08);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(245,158,11,.42);
}

/* ── LIGHTBOX image : zoom fluide ──────────────────────────── */
.vp-lightbox {
  animation: vpFadeIn .25s ease both;
}
.vp-lightbox-inner img {
  animation: vpScaleIn .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both;
}

/* ── RESPONSIVE TWEAKS : conserver la fluidité sur mobile ─── */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .vp-hero {
    padding: 1.85rem 1.1rem 1.25rem;
  }
  .vp-hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(24px, 7vw, 42px);
    letter-spacing: -.04em;
    line-height: 1.08;
  }
  .vp-hero-eyebrow { font-size: 9.5px; margin-bottom: .85rem; }
  .vp-ratio { border-radius: 16px; }
  .vp-ratio iframe { border-radius: 16px; }
  .vp-ratio::before { border-radius: 18px; }
  .vp-player-glow { inset: 25% 8% -15%; filter: blur(40px); }
}

@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .vp-ratio { border-radius: 14px; }
  .vp-ratio iframe { border-radius: 14px; }
  .vp-ratio::before { border-radius: 16px; inset: -1px; }
  .vp-reactions-bar {
    gap: .75rem;
    padding-top: .25rem;
  }
  .vp-reactions { gap: .35rem; }
  .vp-reaction-btn { min-height: 2.1rem; padding: 0 .6rem; font-size: 12.5px; }
  .vp-traded-btn { font-size: 12px; min-height: 2.2rem; }
  .vp-desc-card { padding: 1.1rem 1.15rem 1.2rem 1.05rem; }
  .vp-side-card { padding: 1rem 1.05rem; }
  .vp-comments {
    margin: 1.25rem auto 2rem;
    padding: 0 .9rem;
  }
  .vp-comments-hd { padding: .85rem 1.1rem; }
  .vp-comment-item { padding: .95rem 1.1rem; }
  .vp-comment-body { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; }
}

@media (max-width: 380px) {
  .vp-hero { padding: 1.1rem .85rem .95rem; }
  .vp-hero-title { font-size: clamp(20px, 7.5vw, 30px); }
  .vp-hero-chips { gap: .35rem; }
  .vp-chip { font-size: 10.5px; padding: .22rem .65rem; }
}

/* ── Accessibilité : respecter prefers-reduced-motion ─────── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .vp-hero,
  .vp-player-stage,
  .vp-desc-card,
  .vp-side-card,
  .vp-tournament-promo,
  .vp-comments,
  .vp-comment-item,
  .vp-locked-content,
  .vp-hero-rule,
  .vp-hero-title { animation: none !important; }
  .vp-hero::before,
  .vp-hero::after,
  .vp-player-glow,
  .vp-ratio::before,
  .vp-tp-trophy,
  .vp-tp-glow,
  .vp-locked-lock-wrap::after,
  .vp-reaction-btn.active,
  .vp-traded-btn.active { animation: none !important; }
  .vp-hero-rule { width: 52px !important; }
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    transition-duration: .01ms !important;
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ADMIN — Recharges Paper Trading (compteur + liste + fiche)
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Couleurs P&L (fallback pour les pages admin) */
.pt-pos-color { color: #34d399 !important; }
.pt-neg-color { color: #f87171 !important; }

/* ── Bloc compteur dans l'accueil admin ────────────────────── */
.admin-topup-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px;
  margin-left: 6px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #059669, #34d399);
  color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800;
  vertical-align: 1px;
}

/* ── Cartes statistiques (page liste recharges) ────────────── */
.ptt-stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: .9rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.ptt-stat {
  background: var(--card, rgba(255,255,255,.03));
  border: 1px solid var(--gb, rgba(255,255,255,.08));
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
}
.ptt-stat--revenue {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(5,150,105,.14), rgba(52,211,153,.06));
  border-color: rgba(52,211,153,.35);
}
.ptt-stat-label {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--t3); margin-bottom: .4rem;
}
.ptt-stat-value {
  font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; color: var(--t1);
  letter-spacing: -.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.ptt-stat--revenue .ptt-stat-value { color: #34d399; }

.ptt-list-hd {
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--t3); margin-bottom: .75rem;
}

/* ── Lignes de la liste des joueurs rechargés ──────────────── */
.ptt-row { gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.ptt-uid {
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--t3);
  background: var(--g1, rgba(255,255,255,.05));
  border-radius: 5px; padding: 1px 5px; margin-left: 4px;
}
.ptt-row-figures {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.4rem;
  flex: 1; justify-content: flex-end;
}
.ptt-fig { text-align: right; }
.ptt-fig-val {
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--t1);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.ptt-fig-count { color: #a78bfa; }
.ptt-fig-rev   { color: #34d399; }
.ptt-fig-lbl   { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--t3); margin-top: 1px; }
.ptt-profile-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; white-space: nowrap; }

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .ptt-stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .ptt-row-figures { gap: .9rem; }
  .ptt-fig-date { display: none; }
}

/* ── Fiche joueur ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ptu-head {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem;
  background: var(--card, rgba(255,255,255,.03));
  border: 1px solid var(--gb, rgba(255,255,255,.08));
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}
.ptu-avatar { width: 52px; height: 52px; font-size: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.ptu-head-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.ptu-name {
  font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 900; color: var(--t1);
  margin: 0 0 .25rem;
}
.ptu-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--t3); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; align-items: center; }
.ptu-email { color: #a78bfa; text-decoration: none; }
.ptu-email:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.ptu-sep { opacity: .4; }

.ptu-block {
  background: var(--card, rgba(255,255,255,.03));
  border: 1px solid var(--gb, rgba(255,255,255,.08));
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
}
.ptu-block--topup {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(5,150,105,.1), rgba(52,211,153,.03));
  border-color: rgba(52,211,153,.3);
}
.ptu-block-hd {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .07em; color: var(--t3);
  margin-bottom: .9rem;
}
.ptu-block-count {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0;
  color: #a78bfa; text-transform: none;
}
.ptu-empty { font-size: 13px; color: var(--t3); padding: .5rem 0; }

.ptu-topup-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .5rem; }
.ptu-topup-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: .6rem .8rem;
  background: var(--g1, rgba(255,255,255,.04));
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.ptu-topup-main { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: .6rem; }
.ptu-topup-amt  { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; color: #34d399; }
.ptu-topup-tour { font-size: 12px; color: var(--t2); }
.ptu-topup-detail { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--t3); flex: 1; }
.ptu-topup-date { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--t3); white-space: nowrap; }

.ptu-tour-figs { display: flex; gap: 1.3rem; }
.ptu-fig { text-align: right; }
.ptu-fig-val { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--t1); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ptu-fig-lbl { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--t3); margin-top: 1px; }

.ptu-tour-status {
  display: inline-block; margin-left: .4rem;
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .04em; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 99px;
}
.ptu-tour-status--active { background: rgba(52,211,153,.16); color: #34d399; }
.ptu-tour-status--ended  { background: rgba(148,163,184,.16); color: #94a3b8; }
.ptu-tour-status--upcoming { background: rgba(167,139,250,.16); color: #a78bfa; }

.ptu-side {
  display: inline-block; margin-left: .35rem;
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 99px;
}
.ptu-side--long  { background: rgba(52,211,153,.15); color: #34d399; }
.ptu-side--short { background: rgba(248,113,113,.15); color: #f87171; }

.ptu-orders { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .3rem; }
.ptu-order-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.4fr .7fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: .6rem; align-items: center;
  padding: .45rem .7rem;
  background: var(--g1, rgba(255,255,255,.03));
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.ptu-order-row--liq { background: rgba(239,68,68,.1); }
.ptu-order-type  { font-weight: 700; color: var(--t2); }
.ptu-order-tok   { font-weight: 800; color: var(--t1); }
.ptu-order-total { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--t2); }
.ptu-order-date  { text-align: right; color: var(--t3); font-size: 11px; }

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .ptu-head { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .ptu-order-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .ptu-order-date { display: none; }
}

/* ── Bandeau « Maintenance programmée » (home / login publics) ── */
.maint-banner {
  position: relative; z-index: 60;
  margin: 1rem auto 1.5rem; max-width: 1100px;
  padding: .85rem 1rem;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(245,158,11,.16), rgba(124,58,237,.12));
  border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.4);
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 36px -18px rgba(245,158,11,.5);
  animation: maintBannerIn .35s var(--ease) both;
}
@keyframes maintBannerIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.maint-banner--live {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(239,68,68,.18), rgba(245,158,11,.12));
  border-color: rgba(239,68,68,.45);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 36px -18px rgba(239,68,68,.55);
}
.maint-banner-inner { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem; }
.maint-banner-icon {
  flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 1.55rem; line-height: 1;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(245,158,11,.5));
  animation: maintIconPulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.maint-banner--live .maint-banner-icon { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(239,68,68,.55)); }
@keyframes maintIconPulse { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(0); } 25% { transform: rotate(-12deg); } 75% { transform: rotate(12deg); } }
.maint-banner-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.maint-banner-title {
  font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: #fcd34d; margin-bottom: .25rem;
}
.maint-banner--live .maint-banner-title { color: #fca5a5; }
.maint-banner-text { font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--t1, #eeeef8); }
.maint-banner-text strong { color: #fcd34d; font-weight: 800; }
.maint-banner--live .maint-banner-text strong { color: #fca5a5; }
.maint-banner-message {
  display: block; margin-top: .35rem;
  font-size: .82rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--t2, #9898c8);
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .maint-banner { margin: .8rem .9rem 1rem; padding: .8rem .9rem; }
  .maint-banner-text { font-size: .85rem; }
}
html.light .maint-banner {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(245,158,11,.1), rgba(124,58,237,.05));
  border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.35);
}
html.light .maint-banner-title { color: #b45309; }
html.light .maint-banner-text { color: #1a1140; }
html.light .maint-banner-text strong { color: #b45309; }
html.light .maint-banner--live .maint-banner-text strong { color: #b91c1c; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .maint-banner, .maint-banner-icon { animation: none; }
}

/* ── Bannière d'impersonation admin ─────────────────────────── */
.impersonation-banner {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  z-index: 9999;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .75rem;
  padding: .5rem 1.25rem;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7c3aed, #b45309);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: .8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
.impersonation-banner span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .4rem;
}
.impersonation-banner strong { font-weight: 900; }
.impersonation-banner-stop {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: .75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: .25rem .75rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .15s;
}
.impersonation-banner-stop:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.28); }
/* Décale le contenu pour que la bannière ne masque pas le header */
body:has(.impersonation-banner) .app { padding-top: 36px; }
